name: briefing_action_play_sample_tick
description: HudUiBriefingAction_PlaySample::Tick stops the current briefing sound, looks up the named sample, starts simple or variant playback when found, and treats missing variant samples as complete by raising the progress event code.
known_limits: The smoke covers the missing variant-sample branch with an empty sample registry; found-sample playback behavior is source-reviewed against Binary Ninja and accepted zSnd direct callees.
tier S verification is deferred to a coherent briefing action cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x404aa0 validates optional current-handle StopIfActive, zSnd::FindSampleByName, missing variant sample setting g_Briefing_ProgressEventCode to 999, simple playback via PlayA3DSimple, variant playback via SetPlaybackEventHandler(Briefing::SampleEventCallback) and PlayDirectSound, storing g_Briefing_CurrentSndHandle, and return 1.
The native smoke invokes the real play-sample action Tick through its action vtable with an empty sample registry and validates return 1, no current handle, and missing-variant progress code 999.
